name: probe_col
doc: Probe a vertical line of tiles for belts; logs which y have a belt at x.
author: serf

name: follow_belt
doc: Follow a belt from x,y along its direction up to n steps; returns the final belt position/dir.
author: serf

name: follow_belt
doc: Follow a belt from x,y along its direction; jumps 10 tiles when the belt there has same dir. Returns final position (rerun from it). Up to ~55 inspects.
author: serf

name: follow_belt
doc: Follow a belt from x,y; jumps 40/10 tiles when the belt there has same dir, else single step. Rerun from returned position.
author: serf
